name: No mutation
lesson: Without mutation selection and crossover can only recombine what is already in the population, so it collapses to copies of one chromosome that can never improve.
lookFor: With this seed all 12 individuals are the same chromosome by generation 100 and the best fitness stays at 14: stepping a generation changes nothing, and Run until stop pauses at generation 72 for stagnation. Over seeds 1 to 100 no run finds 20 and every run ends with identical individuals. The run is expected to stall.
